title: Nikon SLM Solutions material data sheet AlSi10Mg, MDS_AlSi10Mg_2025-11.1_EN
notes: Downloaded and read as text on 2026-11-12 (SHA-256 of the file read: 0a53f2712f49bc79732602db03a6099418d48df19e91e5c6646f58ae23df6220; the file is not stored). Powder particle size 20 to 63 micrometres. As-built roughness on vertical walls, DIN EN ISO 21920-3:2022 with a 2.5 mm cut-off, mean and maximum at 95 % coverage and 95 % confidence: SLM 280 at 30 micrometre layers Ra 11 / 22 and Rz 64 / 120 micrometres; SLM 500 at 30 micrometres Ra 11 / 22 and Rz 70 / 129; SLM 280 at 60 micrometres Ra 23 / 33 and Rz 134 / 178; SLM 280 at 90 micrometres Ra 16 / 23 and Rz 93 / 128. The roughness footnote also mentions corundum and glass-bead blasting, so whether the as-built row is before any blasting is not stated beyond its label. The sheet states no dimensional accuracy, no minimum wall, no minimum feature and no fillet or corner radius. It is another machine than the EOS M 290 card of this catalogue.
